exposure: number of common illnesses in infants
number of common pains in mothers
cohort: 435 families with infants (≤6 months old) in the Chinese Qinba Mountains region
finding: Infant overall health status and mothers experiencing over two common pains within two weeks after delivery were risk factors for postpartum depression, while maternal overall health status, infants with mild and severe stunted growth, maternal C-section, and postpartum body mass index (normal or overweight) were not.
mod_finding: Maternal C-section was not correlated with postpartum depression.
